options.name: force
options.description: Force the change of the cluster state.

options.name: name
options.description: Specify which node of the cluster you want to manage. V(null) == the cluster status itself, V(all) == check the status of all nodes.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the cluster. The value V(maintenance) has been added in community.general 11.1.0.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout period (in seconds) for polling the cluster operation.
